technique_name: Tân Hải Píng Héng (Exploring the Ocean Balance)

questions.question: What is the error code for Tân Hải Píng Héng (Exploring the Ocean Balance)?
What are the two main deduction points for Tân Hải Píng Héng?
questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) Supporting leg is bent, and 2) Raised leg is bent.
choices: Deductions are applied when: 1) The knee of the front leg is not above the instep, 2) The thigh of the bending front leg is not parallel to the ground, 3) Any portion of the sole of the rear leg is obviously off the floor, 4) The rear foot is not hooked inwards with the toes pointing obliquely forwards.
Deductions are applied when: 1) Supporting leg is bent, and 2) Raised leg is bent.

Deductions are applied when: 1) Spear head not travelling in a clearly defined arc, 2) Rear handle of spear end protrudes from the grip, 3) The thrusting arm and spear shaft do not form a horizontal straight line.
The sole of the sweeping foot should maintain contact with the ground throughout the sweeping action without leaving the ground after making contact.

questions.question: How should both legs be positioned in a correct Tân Hải Píng Héng balance technique?
questions.answer: Both the supporting leg and the raised leg should be completely straight, with no bending at the knees.
choices: Both the supporting leg and the raised leg should be completely straight, with no bending at the knees.
The toes of the slapped foot should be above shoulder height and the slap should be audible.
The front and rear legs should form two parallel straight lines.
Deductions are applied when: 1) Pushing leg does not transit from an obvious bend of 45 degrees or more to completely straight, 2) Pushing leg is below horizontal level.
